name: Ritz-Carlton Beijing, Financial Street
positioning: Ritz-Carlton hotel in Beijing's Financial Street area with Chinese-inspired design (official name: The Ritz-Carlton Beijing, Financial Street)
best_for: Travelers who want a Chinese-inspired design hotel with direct access to a shopping mall
Families, since children can check in at their own reception staircase

facts.text: Four tall banyan trees grow in the main lounge.
The hotel lobby has direct access to the Seasons Place shopping mall.
Qi is the hotel's Cantonese restaurant, which uses locally sourced, fresh ingredients whenever possible.
Greenfish is the hotel's all-day dining venue on the lobby level.
The Crystal Lounge and bar takes its name from the crystal slab that makes up its long countertop.
The pool is a heated indoor lap pool with soaking tub beds.
Club-level rooms are on the 18th floor, and the club lounge offers five food and beverage presentations throughout the day.
The fitness center has windows facing the pool.

highlights.text: The indoor swimming pool has a movie screen at one end that shows black-and-white vintage films.
The hotel's design draws on Feng Shui philosophy and its symbols.
Outside each guest room door is a liuli crystal animal sculpture meant as a good luck charm.
Decorative wooden lattice patterns cover the lobby's glass walls and showcase symbols of long life and good fortune.
One of the reception desks has a small staircase that lets children climb up and check in themselves.

considerations.text: The hotel does not provide an airport shuttle service.
The hotel is surrounded by office buildings and a luxury shopping mall in the center of the Financial Street area.
Regular upkeep keeps the design current while retaining many of the original furnishings, woodwork and design pieces from opening day.
